$comment: Authored by reading local-alleles-v4.5.vcf and the VCF 4.5 Number=LR rule, before the query was run. Derived from the source text, never from converter output.

expectedRows.why: LAA=2,4 makes the local set REF,ALT2,ALT4; LAD=20,30,10 therefore gives ALT2 (C) a depth of 30.
LAA=3 makes the local set REF,ALT3; LAD=15,25 therefore gives ALT3 (T) a depth of 25.

excludedRows.why: Flagged, and ALT1 is in the file, but 1 is not in LAA=2,4 -- this sample reports no depth for it. A positional reading of Number=LR would hand it the second LAD value, 30, and wrongly report it above threshold.
Flagged, but 1 is not in LAA=3. A positional reading would hand it 25 and wrongly report it above threshold.
Flagged, but 1 is not in LAA=3, so no depth. Under a positional reading it would take 1, which is below threshold and so excluded either way -- this row does not discriminate.

discriminates: Two of the three excluded rows are excluded ONLY when Number=LR is resolved through the sample's LAA. The answer therefore depends on the modelling choice, not merely on the data being present.
